features.name: Valley Green Inn and trailhead
features.description: Valley Green is the best-known Wissahickon arrival for the inn, creek views, and Forbidden Drive; parking is limited and fills early.
features.source_label: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon

details.informationSourceLabel: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon
details.imageAlt: Valley Green Inn and trailhead at Wissahickon Valley Park

features.name: Forbidden Drive
features.description: Forbidden Drive is the broad creekside gravel route through the Wissahickon, shared by walkers, runners, cyclists, and permitted equestrians.
features.source_label: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon

details.informationSourceLabel: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon
details.imageAlt: Forbidden Drive at Wissahickon Valley Park

features.name: Devil's Pool and Livezey Lane
features.description: Devil's Pool is reached from trail access near Livezey Lane; swimming and wading are prohibited, and wet rock and steep approaches require care.
features.source_label: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon

details.informationSourceLabel: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon
details.imageAlt: Devil's Pool and Livezey Lane at Wissahickon Valley Park

features.name: Wissahickon Environmental Center and Andorra Meadow
features.description: The environmental center and Andorra Meadow form a quieter northern gateway with nature programming, meadow habitat, and trail connections.
features.source_label: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon

details.informationSourceLabel: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon
details.imageAlt: Wissahickon Environmental Center and Andorra Meadow at Wissahickon Valley Park

features.name: Thomas Mill Covered Bridge
features.description: Thomas Mill Covered Bridge crosses the creek beside Forbidden Drive in the northern valley and is reached on foot, bike, or horse rather than by driving across it.
features.source_label: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon

details.informationSourceLabel: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon
details.imageAlt: Thomas Mill Covered Bridge at Wissahickon Valley Park

features.name: Fingerspan Bridge
features.description: Fingerspan is a sculptural pedestrian bridge on a natural-surface side trail above the creek; reaching it requires trail navigation, grades, and sure footing.
features.source_label: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon

details.informationSourceLabel: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon
details.imageAlt: Fingerspan Bridge at Wissahickon Valley Park

features.name: Blue Bell Park trailhead
features.description: Blue Bell Park is a southern Wissahickon gateway with parking, open lawn, picnic space, and trail access; weekend spaces can fill before the interior valley lots.
features.source_label: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon

details.informationSourceLabel: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon
details.imageAlt: Blue Bell Park trailhead at Wissahickon Valley Park

features.name: Rex Avenue trailhead
features.description: Rex Avenue is a steep western trailhead for hikers seeking upper trails and creek connections; neighborhood parking is limited and the return climb is substantial.
features.source_label: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation / Friends of the Wissahickon
